integrity: General result follows from exact majority-increment and Beta-moment identities and a positive-root quadratic argument; auxiliary rational checks are finite only; bibliographic equivalence cannot be excluded without inaccessible older full texts.
scientific_limitations: Only conditional iid votes with a common Beta-distributed latent competence, fixed shape parameters, odd simple-majority rule, and an equal-marginal independent comparator; no extension asserted for arbitrary mixtures or strategic juries.
title: A unique finite peak in independence optimism for Beta-mixed majority juries
